artifact_observations.reasoning: Faint, repetitive watermark-like text patterns are visible across the black background. They are illegible and appear to be AI-generated noise mimicking stock photo watermarks.

The raw meat beneath the cleaver lacks structural integrity; it appears smeared and melted into the background rather than sitting as a distinct solid object. The edges of the meat blend unnaturally with the black void.
The metal texture is overly smooth and uniform, lacking the micro-scratches, reflections, or imperfections typically found on a used or even new steel blade.

To audit the boundary sharpness between the metal blade and the organic meat, checking for fusion or bleeding artifacts.
To analyze the illegible background patterns and confirm if they are nonsensical AI artifacts or recognizable watermarks.
To assess the realism of the lighting and shadows, particularly the lack of contact shadow between the floating cleaver and the meat.

focus_areas: Realism of meat texture and structure
Legibility and nature of background text patterns
